description_en: Queries whether one or more IP addresses are assigned to Alibaba Cloud CDN
description_zh: 调用BatchDescribeCdnIpInfo批量查询IP是否为阿里云CDN服务IP
name: BatchDescribeCdnIpInfo

parameters.help_en:
The list of IP addresses to query. Separate IP addresses with commas (,). You can specify up to 20 IP addresses at a time.

> - Example of an IPv4 address: 192.0.2.1
>
> - Example of an IPv6 address: 2001:db8:ffff:ffff:ffff:\*\*\*\*:ffff
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的IP地址列表参数，IP地址之间用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次性最多查询20个IP地址。

>- IPv4举例：192.0.2.1。
>- IPv6举例：2001:db8:ffff:ffff:ffff:****:ffff
parameters.name: ip_addr_list

parameters.help_en:
The language of the query results. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Simplified Chinese.

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果语言控制。取值：
- **zh**（默认值）：简体中文。
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: language
